scenario: A gallery curator is assigning seven paintings—Amethyst, Bravo, Cascade, Diorite, Ember, Forge, and Garnet—to exactly two museum wings: the North Wing and the South Wing. The North Wing will display four paintings, and the South Wing will display three paintings. The paintings are assigned according to the following constraints.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be a complete and accurate assignment of the paintings to the two wings?

choices.label: A
choices.text: North Wing: Amethyst, Bravo, Cascade, Diorite; South Wing: Ember, Forge, Garnet

choices.label: B
choices.text: North Wing: Amethyst, Bravo, Cascade, Ember; South Wing: Diorite, Forge, Garnet

choices.label: C
choices.text: North Wing: Amethyst, Bravo, Diorite, Forge; South Wing: Cascade, Ember, Garnet

choices.label: D
choices.text: North Wing: Amethyst, Cascade, Ember, Garnet; South Wing: Bravo, Diorite, Forge

choices.label: E
choices.text: North Wing: Bravo, Cascade, Diorite, Ember; South Wing: Amethyst, Forge, Garnet

explanations.correct: North Wing: Amethyst, Bravo, Cascade, Ember; South Wing: Diorite, Forge, Garnet. Amethyst and Bravo are together (✓); Cascade and Diorite are in different wings (✓); Ember is in North Wing (✓); Forge is in South Wing (✓); Garnet is in South Wing, so the conditional does not apply (✓).
explanations.A: Ember must be in the North Wing, not the South Wing. Violates the rule that Ember is assigned to North Wing.
explanations.C: Forge must be in the South Wing, not the North Wing. Violates the rule that Forge is not assigned to North Wing.
explanations.D: Amethyst and Bravo must be assigned to the same wing, but Amethyst is in North and Bravo is in South. Violates the same_group constraint.
explanations.E: Amethyst and Bravo must be assigned to the same wing, but Amethyst is in South and Bravo is in North. Violates the same_group constraint.

questions.questionStem: If Cascade is assigned to the North Wing, which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Garnet is assigned to the South Wing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Diorite is assigned to the North Wing.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Garnet is assigned to the North Wing.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Forge is assigned to the North Wing.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Diorite is assigned to the South Wing.

explanations.correct: If Cascade is in the North Wing, then Diorite must be in the South Wing (different_group). Since Cascade is in North, the conditional 'if Garnet in North then Cascade in South' has a false antecedent, so Garnet could be anywhere. However, examining the verified solutions with Cascade in North: the only one is North Wing: Amethyst, Bravo, Cascade, Ember; South Wing: Diorite, Forge, Garnet. Garnet is in South Wing. Checking the logical chain: the conditional states if Garnet is in North, then Cascade is in South. The contrapositive is: if Cascade is in North, then Garnet is in South. So Garnet must be in South Wing.
explanations.B: Diorite must be in the South Wing (different from Cascade). This is false.
explanations.C: Garnet can be in the South Wing. By contrapositive of the conditional, if Cascade is North then Garnet is South.
explanations.D: Forge must be in the South Wing. Violates the rule that Forge is not in North Wing.
explanations.E: Diorite must be in the South Wing, but the choice says it is assigned to the South Wing, which is true but not necessary by itself—the real inference is the contrapositive of the conditional.

explanations.A: By the conditional, if Garnet is in North then Cascade must be in South. Cascade cannot be in North.
explanations.B: Diorite must be different from Cascade. If Cascade is in South, Diorite could be in North or South. However, with Garnet and Amethyst, Bravo, Ember fixed, there is room for Diorite in North or South, but the verified solution shows Diorite in South. Let me recheck: North has Amethyst, Bravo, Ember, Garnet (4 paintings). South has Cascade (forced), Diorite, Forge (3 paintings). Diorite is in South in the only verified solution.
explanations.C: Forge must not be in North Wing.
